headline: 大草原小屋重啟版開播
context: 經典影集《大草原上的小屋》(Little House on the Prairie) 推出重啟版，劇評形容這是一齣精雕細琢的溫馨劇，充滿信仰、希望與美式價值。紐約時報則指出，新版特別留了空間，講述英格斯家族（Ingalls family）定居草原之前，原本住在那裡的人。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Like tradwifery for children, this revamp of the 19th-century settlers show is a precision-tooled and well-oiled machine. It’s a cosy world full of faith, hope and the American way I never actually watched an episode of Little House on the Prairie, though it bestrode my late 70s-early 80s’ childhood like a ginghamed colossus. This is for the simple reason that Michael Landon’s bouffant hair frightened me. Bouffant hair is such a bad thing. But so great is the power of both the cultural cringe and osmosis that even the most militant Britisher of a certain age has absorbed to some degree the story of the pioneering Ingalls family and its on-screen aesthetic. For the younger folk – it’s tradwifery for children. The series was of course based on the books (and named after the third in the series, which was published in 1935 and hasn’t been out of print since) by Laura Ingalls Wilder. They in turn were an account, shaped for a young readership, of her childhood spent moving across the American West in the 1870s and 80s, settling and resettling in different states as her parents sought their manifest destiny. sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: The classic story (and recent culture-war object) remains wholesome but makes room for people who called the prairie home before the Ingalls family.

thread_text:
《大草原小屋》重啟版開播

經典影集《大草原上的小屋》(Little House on the Prairie) 推出重啟版，劇評形容這是一齣「精雕細琢」的溫馨劇，滿滿信仰、希望與美式價值，看得讓人想念一個比較簡單的世界。紐約時報則指出，新版特別留了空間，講述英格斯家族（Ingalls family）定居草原之前，原本住在那裡的人。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 7 月 9 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
《大草原小屋》重啟版開播

經典影集《大草原上的小屋》(Little House on the Prairie) 推出重啟版，劇評形容這是一齣「精雕細琢」的溫馨劇，充滿信仰、希望與美式價值，看幾集就讓人懷念起一個比較簡單的世界。紐約時報的角度不太一樣，它特別提到新版留了空間，講述英格斯家族定居草原之前，原本住在當地的人。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 7 月 9 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 經典影集《大草原上的小屋》推出重啟版。劇評形容這是一齣精雕細琢的溫馨劇，充滿信仰、希望與美式價值，看幾集就讓人懷念起一個比較簡單的世界。不過也有評論指出，新版特別留了空間，講述英格斯家族定居草原之前，原本住在當地的人。
